title.narrative: % improved access among smallholder farmers to climate smart agriculture knowledge and support

description.narrative: % improved access among smallholder farmers to climate smart agriculture knowledge and support

comment.narrative: Based on the baseline findings there is a high probability of knowledge transfer occurring between farmers directly rather than using other sources of information the baseline reported the percentage to be 59.2 which means that more than half the farmers rely on other farmers as the main source of agricultural information. The second rank goes to extension officers 22.4 followed by the agriculture cooperatives 20.2. Finally only 9.9 of farmers reported using Media as a source of information.

It is anticipated that the project will contribute to increasing the percentage through documenting the CSA practices through social media channels and publishing tutorial videos that will improve access among small farmers to CSA knowledge. This will be documented during the final evaluation the success stories booklet and the final documentary.
